files.cached: Refresh failed; showing previously loaded entries.
files.limit: Display limited to 400 entries; collapse folders to see more.
files.snapshot: Saved image files; running changes appear after saving. Select a file for metadata.
images.title: Images
images.hint: Immutable filesystem snapshots, not running VMs. Includes image pages, lane checkpoints and results from the latest 100 operations; not an exhaustive account inventory.
compact.rawMetrics: Raw server resource statistics; units and aggregation unconfirmed. Not live utilization.
compact.search: Search loaded images by tag, UUID or lane
snapshots.title: Snapshot
snapshots.following: Following the lane head. Lists up to 20 recorded snapshots.
snapshots.readonly: Browsing a fixed snapshot; this does not change the lane head.
history.scope: Up to 50 recent tasks saved locally; available after restart, even offline.
history.confirm: Clear saved sandbox history across sessions? Earlier tasks will stay hidden. Cloud operations, images and lanes are not deleted.
lane.confirmDrop: Remove global lane {name}? It disappears from all sessions; image files remain.
images.noDelete: The current interface exposes no image deletion. Dropping a lane keeps its images.
detail.unknownMethod: This historical record has no call method; it cannot be recovered from the UUID.
preview.title: File preview
preview.skipped: Preview supports ordinary text files up to 256 KiB; binary files, symlinks and unknown sizes are not previewed.
taskView.encoded: Encoded output; expand raw response to inspect.
tasks.empty: No saved tasks yet. Available cloud history will load when connected.
tasks.saved: Result snapshot returned; files can be reused
tasks.temporary: Disposable run: file changes are not saved as a new snapshot
tasks.noSnapshot: Save requested, but no new snapshot returned yet; execution may be incomplete or files unchanged
tasks.laneAdvanced: Lane {name} now points to this image
tasks.cpu: Raw CPU statistic: {n} (unit unconfirmed; — means unavailable)
tasks.memory: Raw memory statistic: {n} (unit unconfirmed; — means unavailable)
tasks.logsNotice: Logs and results may be truncated by the server; this is not a live log stream.
browse.missing: Path or image unavailable: {path}. Return to root to check this snapshot.
pane.title: Sandbox
pane.server.refused: contree server: connected, but the API refused the key or project: {message}
pane.server.noAccess: contree server: connected, but this key may not use Sandboxes yet (missing: {missing}). Sandboxes are enabled per project by Nebius; check again once they are.
pane.server.hint: Save your API key and Project ID in Models → Nebius, and make sure uv is installed. Then click Reconnect.
pane.lanes.empty: No lanes yet. Ask the agent to start one (sandbox_lane_new).
tavily.confirmClear: Clear recorded searches across sessions? In-flight searches will not be saved. This does not change your Tavily account.
tavily.empty: No searches yet. Enter a query above.
tavily.historyError: Could not update history. Try refreshing.
tavily.title: Tavily
tavily.truncated: Showing a bounded preview; some results or text may be omitted.
setup.title: Setup
setup.by.agent: you do this with your shell tool
setup.report.ready: Everything is set up. Carry on with the user's request now, without asking again.
setup.report.agent: You do: {items}. Do not hand this to the user and do not ask first: run the command yourself now with your shell tool (Velloc asks the user for permission if its settings want that), then call nebius_setup again.
setup.report.user: The user does: {items}. Tell the user exactly where, in the words above (put it in the same AskUserQuestion if you are asking one), and wait. Never ask for a key or ID in chat.
setup.report.scope: Mention only the lines marked ✗ or ?; nothing else is needed. Do not run anything on this computer in the sandbox's place. As soon as the check passes, carry on with the user's original request.
setup.uv.label: uv (starts the sandbox server)
setup.uv.missing: not installed. Install it with `winget install --id astral-sh.uv -e --source winget` on Windows, or `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` on macOS and Linux, then check again: that reconnects the sandbox server.
setup.uv.offPath: installed, but not found yet. Press Reconnect in /sandbox or check again; if it is still not found, fully quit Velloc, tray icon included, and reopen it.
setup.uv.noShell: not installed, and this session has no shell to install it. Install it yourself in a terminal (`winget install --id astral-sh.uv -e --source winget` on Windows, `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh` on macOS and Linux), or open an Agent or Code session and ask it to install uv. Then check again here: that reconnects the sandbox server.
setup.uv.viaServer: works: the sandbox server started with it
setup.key.label: Nebius API key
setup.key.viaFile: not saved in Velloc; the sandbox server reads ~/.config/contree/auth.ini
setup.key.missing: not saved. Save it in Models → Nebius (get one at https://tokenfactory.nebius.com/).
setup.project.label: Project ID
setup.project.viaFile: not set in Velloc; the sandbox server reads ~/.config/contree/auth.ini
setup.project.missing: not set. Enter it in Models → Nebius → Project ID: the Nebius project that has Sandboxes.
setup.server.label: Sandbox server
setup.server.failed: not connected ({reason}). Fix the lines above, then press Reconnect in /sandbox or check again.
setup.server.stale: did not start earlier in this session, and this version of Velloc does not start it again here. Start a new session in this folder: it starts the server with uv as it is now. Velloc 1.155.2.6 or later reconnects without a new session.
setup.server.waiting: starts by itself once the lines above are done.
setup.access.label: Sandbox access
setup.access.failed: Nebius refused the key or project: {message}. Check both in Models → Nebius.
setup.access.missing: this project cannot use Sandboxes yet (missing: {missing}). Ask Nebius to enable Sandboxes for it, then press Reconnect in /sandbox.
setup.image.label: Default image
setup.image.missing: not set. Name an image in each call, or set one in Settings → Plugins & Mods → nebius (e.g. tag:python:3.12).
setup.tavily.label: Tavily API key (web search)
setup.tavily.missing: not saved. Get one at https://tavily.com and save it in Models → Nebius → Tavily API key; if search is still missing, start a new session.
safecode.denied: SafeCode refused {tool}: {path} is outside the session folder. A SafeCode session may read and write only inside its project folder, its memory directory and its scratchpad. Do not retry with another path outside them; tell the user what you needed and why.
safecode.band: Blocked: the model tried a {tool} on {path}, outside this SafeCode session's folder. SafeCode does not allow it.
safecode.bandMany: Blocked {count} operations SafeCode does not allow. Latest: {tool} on {path}, outside this session's folder.
